% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): ticks outside, only on the left
% and bottom, labels pushed out by the tick length.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[tick align=outside, tick pos=left, xlabel={Outside}, ylabel={Ticks}]
\addplot coordinates {(0,0) (10,30) (20,25) (30,45)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
